## Details

<a id="unused_0801"></a>
### [`unused_0801`](../../../../src/leftovers/leftover_0801.asm#L6) `$0801-$0837`

*data*

Nothing reads or writes these 55 zero bytes. In the RDI crack of build V 05 05 87, $0810-$0837 hold the crack code that copies $b000-$b3e7 to colour RAM and jumps to $8009.
